shopGrant: existing write_products; no extra Shopify scope
prepareSequence: POST shopify-reconcile for the exact original uncertain draft operation
only an original partial, read-confirmed DRAFT is eligible
POST existing shopify-review with the additive repair fields
POST existing shopify-decision with this new operationId/scopeHash
POST existing shopify-execute; response loss retains exact requestId/body
POST existing shopify-reconcile for this repair operation if its result is unknown

reviewBody.approveObservedMedia: optional boolean; must be explicitly true to adopt observed existing media IDs after a lost create response

reviewAdditions.approveObservedMedia: whether explicit observed-ID approval is part of this scope

scopeAdditions.draftOperationId: immutable original operation reference; handle/product/variant identities are reused

receiptRules: success is draft_only and does not grant publication
original create/upload/connectorRun checkpoints stay unchanged; original.repairedBy links the new repair
observed media adoption is labelled separately_approved_observed_ids_and_shopify_status; remoteBytesVerified remains false
already complete variant is read-confirmed without a second variant mutation
unknown repair must be reconciled before publication admission; no automatic retries
failed/missing/unready/substituted media, changed public content, missing upload proof, active products or any admitted publication are blocked
a previously acknowledged variant or completed draft is not a missing-step repair
realShopifyAcceptance: not run; local fixtures never count as actual store execution
